dct_title_s: Mapping the Flow of Ukrainian Refugees to Countries of Asylum by End of 2022
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This dataset depicts global flow lines from Ukraine to countries of asylum, representing Ukrainian refugee populations by end of 2022. Flow lines were generated from UNHCR Refugee Population Statistics Database summary data (Year=2022; Country of Origin=Ukraine; Country of Asylum=All countries) joined to world country centroids and converted into geodesic line features in EPSG:4326 (WGS 84).

Purpose: To support cartographic visualization and analysis of the distribution of Ukrainian refugees across countries of asylum by end of 2022. This dataset was derived and processed for use as part of a Harvard Library GIS training module.
Supplemental information: UNHCR methodology and definitions: https://www.unhcr.org/refugee-statistics/methodology and https://www.unhcr.org/refugee-statistics/methodology/definition.
